servers.name: Eduentry
servers.description: Academic assessment data for children aged 6–17 — grammar school entry requirements, standardised score interpretation, assessed subjects, and multilingual blog posts.

tools.name: explain_scoring
tools.description: Explain what a standardised score means on Eduentry — percentile rank and performance band. UK grammar school entry context included for locale=en.

locale.description: One of: en, es, tr, fr, ar, ru, zh. Defaults to en.

tools.name: list_grammar_areas
tools.description: List UK grammar school areas with entry requirements, exam boards, and target SAS scores. UK-specific — locale must be 'en'.

area.description: Optional slug: kent, buckinghamshire, birmingham, london-barnet, london-sutton, hertfordshire, essex, gloucestershire

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: List the four assessment subjects: English, Mathematics, Verbal Reasoning, Non-Verbal Reasoning. UK/11+ relevance notes for locale=en.

locale.description: One of: en, es, tr, fr, ar, ru, zh.

tools.name: list_tracks
tools.description: List the four internship readiness tracks (Technology, Business, Data Analytics, Digital Marketing) with domain topics, sample roles, and assessment phases.

track.description: Optional track id: tech, business, data-analytics, digital-marketing

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: List Eduentry blog posts across all 7 locales (en, es, tr, fr, ar, ru, zh). Optionally filter by tag keyword.

locale.description: One of: en (default), es, tr, fr, ar, ru, zh

servers.name: Eduentry.ai
servers.description: Internship readiness assessment for high school students aged 14–18 — track details (Technology, Business, Data Analytics, Digital Marketing), assessment phases, and career guidance.
